items.text: The Wandering Market has arrived, kicking off the ever-growing Collections of Skins, cosmetics, and rewards.

Players earn Wandering Market XP through gameplay to unlock Coins and spend them on rewards throughout rotating Collections. Each Collection features multiple reward pages, each with one free page for all players and more pages with more rewards for Premium players. Coins can be saved and spent across any Collection, with no rush—progress at your own pace! With new Collections arriving over time, there’s always something fresh to discover.
Unleash your inner deity with the Rise of the Gods Collection, the first Wandering Market Collection and the ultimate introduction to the boundless realms of SMITE 2!

From the deadly allure of Vixen Nemesis to the bone-chilling might of Lichborne Mordred, the fiery kick of Hot Stuff Poseidon, and the spellbinding charm of Nova Hex Amaterasu, there’s something for everyone.
Learn more about the Wandering Market system here.
(SMITE 1 Parity) Titans now have similar targeting rules as Towers & Phoenixes
Will maintain their target until that target dies, leaves its range, or becomes Untargetable
Exception: If an enemy God within its range damaged a friendly God, and the Titan is not currently targeting a God, it will switch target to the hostile enemy God
Reduced overall size of their AoE cleave vs Minions
Will no longer mysteriously gravitate towards playermade walls such as Anhur Pillar
(SMITE 1 Parity) Enemy targets are now considered in targeting range only when the center of the target character has crossed into the Tower's radius.
This behavior now matches SMITE 1 and essentially makes Towers' aggro range the same for all characters, regardless of their size
(Previously, it was checking if the edge of the character had crossed into range, so smaller characters like Cupid could stand closer to Tower without being targeted)
Archers will now attempt to move closer to the enemy Titan when attacking it
Added an unequip button to God loadout
Added a “Wallet” widget to the profile screen so players can more easily see how much of each in-game currency they own
Can now enter practice with selected skins from the God Collections screen
Added contextual ping through VGS and minimap (hold Alt on KBM, hold VGS button on controller).
Note: Pause duration is indefinite in Custom Conquest
Added "Your Turn To Pick" audio and alt-tabbed popup image in Ranked Conquest draft lobby
The Fire Giant, Gold Fury, Pyromancer, and Naga have had their max level increased from 30 to 40
This will give them the capability to scale their stats further into the late game and open up opportunities for us to start adjusting their TTK
Increased the visibility range of Gold Fury and Fire Giant
Fixed big harpies staying at one level higher than normal throughout the match
For example, if all jungle camps were meant to be level 2 the big harpies were at level 3
Increased duration of the objective debuff from 90s to 120s
Decreased base Physical Power by 15% in this mode
Smoothed out collision around the base walls
Improved camera collision behind the bases
Previously players would start the match with their cameras pushed up into their characters

Astral Strike is always active, but you no longer regen Astral Arrows. When out of Astral Arrows, reload. While Infinite Arrows is active, Astral Arrows are not consumed.

Combat Dodge can now be recast after striking a Jungle Monster or Boss, with Spear Strike gaining increased Scaling when forgoing your Armor. Radiant Glory no longer grants increased Protections or Crowd Control Reduction.
Sol's Heat provides Intelligence and Ability Damage, but no longer provides Strength, Attack Speed, and Basic Attack Damage. Sol erupts and deals damage around her when becomes immune in Disapparate.

Divine Presence now defaults to Red Buff, and when activated you gain Movement Speed, Haste, and Basic Attack Power in addition to the original effects. It no longer alternates to Gold Buff, or Heals you when activated.
Passive: If you take damage below 40% health, you unleash a shockwave that Stuns all enemies within a range of 3.2m for 1s and you become CC Immune for 1s. Cooldown 110s.
Tekko Kage and Gem of Focus Rework
These items no longer require Mana, allowing Thanatos and Yemoja to use them.
Abilities with extremely low cooldowns, such as Pele's 3 and Ullr's 4, will prevent item procs on the ability side.
Decreased Cost from 3000 Gold to 2800 Gold.
Passive now deals % Max HP damage instead of % Current HP
Intelligence scaling now applies to the passive effect

Passive: Your abilities deal bonus magical damage over time, equal to 1% + 0.5% of your Intelligence per tick. This effect ticks four times over two seconds. Hitting the same target refreshes the damage over time.

During testing, Ward, Sentry Ward, Cyclops Ward, and Eye of Providence were found to have inconsistent reveal radii and targeting sizes. To ensure these match the intended design from SMITE, the following adjustments have been made:
All descriptions have been updated to use "Radius" instead of "Area" for accuracy
Fixed Explosive Bolts not being able to hit Deployables (Wards, etc)
Fixed Sickle Storm Attacks not being able to hit Deployables (Wards, etc)
